== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes use this skill on allies below a certain health percentage:
** In combat, allies below around 55% health.
** Out of combat, allies below around 70% health.

== Notes ==
* Exceptionally useful against [[spike]]s, due to its fast casting time and large amount of healing.
